title: The Star That Forgot to Die

scenes.text: A thousand light-years away, a star refused to die on schedule.
scenes.art_prompt: a glowing star against deep space, faint nebula, cinematic wonder

scenes.text: It should have collapsed into a neutron star. Instead it just kept burning.
scenes.art_prompt: a dense blue-white star core glowing, magnetic arcs, 3d render

scenes.text: Astronomers found its heartbeat was not a star's heartbeat at all.
scenes.art_prompt: a pulsing light curve on an observatory screen, dark room, wonder

scenes.text: The pulse matched the spin of the core it had been hiding.
scenes.art_prompt: a rapidly spinning stellar core with jets, dramatic 3d render

scenes.text:
It had died long ago. Its light was a shell, a slow echo of a core that is still spinning in the dark.
Some stars do not go out. They keep a promise of light long after the fire is gone.
scenes.art_prompt: a glowing shell of gas around a tiny spinning core, deep space, 3d render

scenes.text: Follow Cosmic Wonders for the next wonder.
scenes.art_prompt: a vast calm nebula with one bright point of light, wonder, quiet and final
